items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: I had to be one of the last ones to make a record with Tiny Parm.

ctx.x: What is this? You like a leucutian teacher or something? No.

That's the only one I can remember and the reason I can remember is because it was brought to my attention. You see the reason I don't remember titles. I was, I had to be one of the last ones to make a record with Tiny Parm. Uh huh. What do you know about, or maybe you don't. Like a little ending would make Dipper Mount. I mean King Oliver made Dipper Mount. We don't know what the title of that thing is. See they make part of the introduction and we hear it and when they knock off we go ahead and play. You know…
